3341.o: Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.

3361.o: Bring Felix’s Box, Felix’s Chest and Felix’s Bucket of Bolts to Felix Whindlebolt in Anvilmar.

3362.o: Tran’rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.

3364.o: Take a Scalding Mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar before it gets cold in five minutes!

3365.o: Return Nori’s Mug to Nori Pridedrift.

3367.o: Help Dorius get back to Ironforge.$B

3368.o: Take the Singed Letter to Thorius in Ironforge. He is in the Hall of Explorers.

3369.o: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise.

3370.o: Bring the Nightmare Shard to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.

3371.o: Return to the Searing Gorge and find Dorius’s archaeology unit.

3372.o: Find the Mysterious Artifact being guarded by the Twilight’s Hammer Idolaters in the northwest quadrant of the Searing Gorge and bring it to the Altar of Suntara in the Slag Pit.$B

3373.o: Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.

3374.o: Bring the Oathstone of Ysera’s Dragonflight and the Chained Essence of Eranikus to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows.  It is there that you will make your choice to aid Ysera’s Dragonflight or not.

3375.o: Bring a Mana Potion, Coal, and Sweet Nectar to Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge to get a replacement for Talvash’s Phial of Scrying.

3376.o: Bring the head of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle to Brave Windfeather in Red Cloud Mesa.

3378.o: Find the Prayer to Elune and take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.$B

3379.o: Kill the group of Shadow Silk Poachers that wander the Searing Gorge. Nilith has reason to believe that there are five of them that need to be exterminated. Return to Nilith in the Searing Gorge when this task is complete.$B

3382.o: Defend Captain Vanessa Beltis, her crew and the Horizon Scout’s passengers against the naga attack. Captain Vanessa Beltis must survive.

3385.o: Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Retrieve the Trader’s Satchel from his corpse and return it to Nilith.$B

3441.o: Listen as Kalaran Windblade tells his story.

3442.o: Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil and return the items to Kalaran Windblade.

3443.o: Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.

3444.o: Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker’s workshop in Ratchet.

3446.o: Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.

3447.o: Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.

3449.o: Using the Drawing Kit, make rubbings of the Rune of Beth’Amara, the Rune of Jin’yael, the Rune of Markri, and the Rune of Sael’hai before heading to the small island off of the southern peninsula of Azshara and signaling Pilot Xiggs Fuselighter to pick them up.

3450.o: Speak to Xiggs Fuselighter in Ironforge.

3451.o: Speak to Xiggs Fuselighter and get a Standard Issue Flare Gun from him in Ironforge.

3452.o: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.

3453.o: Wait for Kalaran Windblade to complete the Torch of Retribution.$B

3461.o: Return Tymor’s Drawing Kit to him in Ironforge.

3463.o: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings. $B

3501.o: Bring Kum’isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.$B

3502.o: Bring Kum’isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the Blasted Lands could be carrying a fragment.$B

3504.o: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Ag’tor Bloodfist in Azshara.

3505.o: Kill 10 Blood Elf Reclaimers, and 10 Blood Elf Surveyors before seeking out Magus Rimtori’s camp. Once you’ve found it, look for something that might be important to her that can be used to draw her into a fight.

3506.o: Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag’tor Bloodfist in Azshara.

3507.o: Speak to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

3508.o: Wait for Loramus to complete the enlightenment spell.

3509.o: Speak with Lord Arkkoroc in Azshara. Begin your search at the waters edge to find the Temple of Arkkoran.

3510.o: Slay Hetaera and bring back Hetaera’s Bloodied Head, Hetaera’s Beaten Head, and Hetaera’s Bruised Head to Lord Arkkoroc.

3511.o: Take the temper back to Loramus Thalipedes.$B

3512.o: Travel to the eastern part of Winterspring and speak with Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.

3513.o: Take the Runed Scroll to the northern guard tower in the Barrens.

3514.o: Kill the leader of the Talon Den, Rynthariel the Keymaster.

3517.o: Find the Tablet of Beth’Amara, the Tablet of Jin’yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael’hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.

3518.o: Bring the Tablet of Beth’Amara to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

3519.o: Speak to Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen.

3520.o: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh’kinya in Steamwheedle Port.

3521.o: Collect 7 Hyacinth Mushrooms, 4 Moonpetal Lilies, and 1 Webwood Ichor for Dirania Silveshine in Shadowglen.

3522.o: Bring Iverron’s Antidote to Iverron before the time limit is up. Iverron can be found by the cave to the north.

3523.o: If you agree to aid Belnistrasz, speak with him again and hand the Oathstone he gave you back to him.

3524.o: Recover Sea Creature Bones from the beached sea creature just south of Auberdine, and then return with it to Gwennyth Bly’Leggonde in Auberdine.

3525.o: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar’s idol in Razorfen Downs.$B$BProtect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.

3526.o: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

3527.o: Bring the First and Second Mosh’aru Tablets to Yeh’kinya in Tanaris.

3528.o: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh’kinya in Tanaris.

3541.o: Bring the Tablet of Jin’yael to Jes’rimon in Orgrimmar.

3542.o: Bring the Tablet of Markri to Andron Gant in Undercity.

3561.o: Bring the Tablet of Sael’hai to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.

3562.o: Deliver Magatha’s Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3563.o: Deliver Jes’rimon’s Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3564.o: Deliver Andron’s Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3565.o: Deliver Xylem’s Note to Jediga in Azshara.

3566.o: Slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion, and return to Thorius in Ironforge with the Head of Lathoric the Black and the Heart of Obsidion.

3568.o: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.

3569.o: Give Cuely’s Elixir to Thersa Windsong in Undercity.
